name: fieldshift
description: Field Shift — Adapting Farms with NASA Data. Decision-support for climate-resilient crop rotation.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @fieldshift/core && npm run build -w @fieldshift/server && npm run build -w @fieldshift/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @fieldshift/core && npm run test -w @fieldshift/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @fieldshift/core && npm run typecheck -w @fieldshift/server && npm run typecheck -w @fieldshift/web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
